name: BPMN 2.x Conformance
summary: Normative BPMN 2.0.2 execution and import coverage, explicit unsupported/partial feature inventory, reviewed semantic tests, mid-flight recovery evidence and independently reproducible conformance reporting. No certification claim.
next_action: Owner review of ADR-0547 (first CON6 slice): accept, amend or reject; on acceptance deliver PR 1 (three stage-5 rules) and PR 2 (element locations) as separate vertical PRs. Open gates unchanged: CON0 per-SHALL denominator sign-off (#1615), CON1 acceptance (#1617), per-clause owner review of CON2/CON3 oracles.

slices.title: Normative inventory and source-to-evidence audit
slices.note: Normative source audit, 13x8 event legality (63 legal), and all 43 revised WCP titles inventoried. Reviewer sign-off on complete SHALL-level denominator and exact §13.1 exclusions remains open; PR #1616 has been superseded by combined PR #1618. Do not mark complete on an inventory count alone.

slices.title: Machine-readable registry and truthful coverage generator
slices.note: Owner-requested combined CON0/CON1 implementation against explicitly frozen provisional CON0 candidate IDs: JSON registry, 105 requirements, 104 event cells, 43 WCPs; Python validator, 15 regression tests, generated evidence report, CI gate, legacy report correction. Dependency exception is implementation-only, not acceptance. Await green final CI, normative per-SHALL review and CON0 sign-off.

slices.title: Supported semantics and negative diagnostic fixtures
slices.note: First increment (PR #1622): execution outcomes for exclusive event race, parallel/inclusive joins and boundary paths; exact rule/severity/element diagnostics for unsupported variants and Complex Gateway. Second increment: inline oracles for terminate end (root and subprocess scope), link throw/catch, error end interrupting a concurrent sibling, escalation end (interrupting) and throw (non-interrupting), signal end, message end and message throw, exclusive default flow and no-route incident, uncontrolled flow without gateways; register now links CON2/CON3 tests to 27 rows (unverified 50 -> 40). Third increment: exact negative diagnostics (normative_diagnostics_test.go) — 8 located rule+element errors, 10 element-local refusals that carry only rule "compile" with no element field, 2 non-blocking warnings, and a characterisation of three spec-forbidden shapes atlas deploys without error (end-event outgoing flow silently never taken; non-outgoing default ignored). FLOW-14 moves to partial. No spec-wide support claim; clause anchors are the provisional register anchors. Owner review of clauses and remaining variants pending.

slices.title: Full-state and mid-flight recovery oracles
slices.note: Thirteen deterministic mid-flight checkpoints: activatable job, message, timer, incident, event-gateway competing waits, non-interrupting boundary (PR #1622), plus in-flight sequential multi-instance, compensation and transaction cancellation awaiting their handler, two concurrent and one half-answered non-interrupting event-subprocess run, and cancellation/compensation thrown from an event subprocess. Restart via WAL into a fresh state; compare durable process, element, job, timer, incident, variable and subscription-count families; repeat Recover and continue. The harness now resumes the restarted clock from the last live reading (a clock reset made post-restart step history sort before pre-restart steps). Remaining: byte-level full-state families and child-scope variables beyond active scopes, checkpoint compaction, clock-regression and failover scenarios.

slices.title: Independent differential validation and portable TCK
slices.note: CON4 expanded independent bpmn-engine translations from four to five control-flow models; enforce non-skipping pinned npm reference CI, compare atlas and portable TCK expected projection. Separate Node/version and executable-dialect limitations remain. Full normative differential breadth and portability acceptance pending.

slices.title: Public normative conformance report and documentation reconciliation
slices.note: Render denominator-specific report; align README, roadmap, TCK docs and conformance gallery with evidence-backed claims.

slices.title: Close genuine BPMN semantics gaps via ADR-gated slices
slices.note: Prioritize Complex Gateway, parallel/instantiating event gateways, cyclic joins and conditional/ad-hoc limits; each approved engine change needs its own ADR and recovery tests. First proposed slice: ADR-0547 (Proposed, not accepted) — stage-5 deploy refusal of start events with incoming flows, end events with outgoing flows and gateway defaults that are not the gateway's own outgoing flow (including the silent cross-gateway mis-route found in CON2), reload stays tolerant per ADR-0177/ADR-0393; plus element locations on element-local compile diagnostics. Implementation waits for owner acceptance of the ADR.
